topics.title: Write a paragraph about a visit to a village.
guiding_questions: When did you visit the village?
How did you feel about the visit?
topics.sample_essay: Last summer, I visited a small village with my family. First, we took a bus and arrived in the morning. Then, we walked in green fields and saw many trees. After that, we ate lunch with a kind man. Finally, we watched the sun go down. I felt so happy. It was a great day.

topics.title: Write about a decision you have made recently.
guiding_questions: How did you feel about it?
topics.sample_essay: Last month, I made a big decision. I decided to stop playing games at night. I made this decision after I failed a test. The result was great. My marks got better. I felt so proud of myself. My father was happy too. This decision made me a better student at school and at home.
